entities.summary: Miséricorde Cemetery is one of the major cemeteries in Nantes, France. It is located in the Hauts-Pavés - Saint-Félix district. It was opened in 1793 and over 10,000 people were buried there between then and 2010, such as Pierre Dumoustier.
